text: Based on the provided tool output, the 2021 tree-cover loss within the pine plantation was approximately 81.3 hectares. The observations indicate that the loss occurred within the planted forest area, with 68.1 hectares of planted forest affected. Additionally, there was a small portion (13.2 hectares) of the loss that occurred outside the mapped forest area. Therefore, the majority of the 2021 loss was indeed inside the pine plantation.
